captions: Tabelle 10: Sachbilanzdaten der Herstellung der Aluminiumbeplankung des Holz-Metallfensterrahmens pro m2
reason: Tabelle 10 (p.26) is the inventory of producing the aluminium panelling ('Aluminiumbeplankung') of the wood-metal WINDOW frame per m2 — this dataset, the aluminium window-frame cover per m2 of visible area. Tabelle 19 (p.34) is the same panelling for an exterior DOOR leaf, a different product, and Tabelle 9 (p.24-25) is the wood-metal window frame itself without surface treatment; p.25 and p.27 are in range for the introducing text and any continuation.
